sqlquery.from: (SELECT (COALESCE(cc.firstname, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(cc.lastname, '')) as fullname, t.journaldate as date, ti.id, (COALESCE(ti.debit, 0) - COALESCE(ti.credit, 0))/1000 as sales from "$".transactionItem ti LEFT JOIN "$".transaction t ON t.id = ti.transactionid JOIN "$".account a ON a.id = ti.accountid LEFT JOIN "$".saleinvoice i ON i.id = t.invoiceid LEFT JOIN "$".crmaccount ca ON ca.id = i.client_id INNER JOIN "$".crmAccount_types typeIDs on typeIDs.crmaccount_id = ca.id INNER JOIN "$".reference types on types.id = typeIDs.type_id LEFT JOIN "$".crmContact cc on cc.crmAccount = ca.id where types.code = 'CUSTOMER' and a.accountcode='0100' and cc.deleted = false and ca.deleted = false) t
